title: Argument as a dependency for now; agent help must teach it (2026-11-04)

sections.name: narrative
sections.content: yes. lets do this for now, but then the agent help needs to teach agents how to use it.

sections.name: source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-04; recorded verbatim. 'this' is Claude Code's recommendation in the same conversation: make the argument package a dependency of the essay package and bundle it with the app, so a new essay has source, claim and problem types without an install step (muDemocracy.org#303, srs-web#590).
